fields.description: Skyblade is a residential tower on Burj Khalifa Boulevard in Downtown Dubai. Its studio-to-three-bedroom collection includes larger terrace configurations, with leisure spaces extending to a rooftop pool and elevated garden setting. The published layout examples distinguish indoor suites from substantial outdoor areas.
amenities: Private pools for selected sky-terrace apartments

overview: The terrace area can change the comparison materially. Check whether a quoted size includes a private leisure area and whether its equipment and maintenance responsibilities form part of the selected sale specification.
research.locationNote: Burj Khalifa Boulevard, Downtown Dubai. The developer describes views toward Burj Khalifa and Dubai Water Canal; the actual outlook depends on orientation, floor and surrounding buildings.
research.priceNote: The retrieved own hero displays FROM AED 1674999. Property Finder gives a higher rounded launch reference around 1.8 m and an FAQ figure 1764999. These are published marketing bases, not evidence of a unit available at the minimum today.
research.paymentNote: The developer FAQ states 20% on signing, 50% during construction and 30% on completion. Property Finder’s summary agrees, but its FAQ incorrectly prints 20/50/40, totalling 110%; that inconsistent row is not adopted. Instalment dates and unit-specific terms remain unconfirmed.
research.handoverNote: The developer schedules completion for Q4 2027. Property Finder gives December 2027, within that quarter. These are forward targets; no actual completion, approval or unit handover is implied.

facts.label: Vertical schedule
facts.value: Own facts specify 4 basements, ground, 3 podiums, an amenity floor, 55 residential and 5 mechanical floors plus roof. Floor-count shorthand should not replace that component schedule.

unresolved: The marketing hero does not confirm available inventory. Exact unit price, parking entitlement, service charges, pool specification and dated commercial terms require written confirmation.
Selected plan totals include balconies; enclosed suite area is separately identified. Printed rounding and the contract govern the selected home, while renders and furniture are illustrative.
